_doc: Implementation settings for the reference kernel. Everything domain-level (levels, questions, the JWF status model) is read from lean-model/kernel-proposal.json; this file holds only the knobs the spec leaves open. Each key names the spec gap it fills.
_done_requires_acceptance: more-lean-model.md §9: 'done = inclusion + gate-accepted passing verification' vs. the state order verified -> accepted -> released(=done). true = released needs the business-acceptance decision too.
_verification_stages: review is a kernel addition (more-lean-model.md §12a): a QG1 guard check, never a test verification.
_validator_methods: verification methods that count as validation for validated_by claims (Lean Profile.validatorMethods).
_relevant: invariants relevant per purpose for purpose-indexed equivalence (MP p.8 C.1). The spec leaves them per organisation; the default uses the ELSTER field-rule invariants (MP B.2: Wertebereich, Pflicht / Optionalität, Kardinalität, Abhängigkeitsbedingung) and adds meaning for acceptance and ordering for operations (Lean Profile.relevant; profile choice, no source).
_roles: board roles per principal (JWF p.9: PO/Fachbereich, Entwicklung, Test/Abnahme, Release/Team). Per organisation; empty by default (Lean Profile.roles).
_acceptor_roles: roles that may take the acceptance decision. JWF p.9: 'fachliche Abnahme' (PO / Fachbereich), 'Abnahmeentscheidung' (Test / Abnahme). Must equal jira_status_model.acceptance.default_acceptor_roles (Lean Profile.acceptorRoles).
